name: solidity-workbench
description: Productivity tools for Solidity and Foundry projects, starting with auto-import of symbols.

solidityWorkbench.foundry.forgePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `forge` executable used to run `forge remappings`. When it cannot be run, remappings are read from `remappings.txt`, `foundry.toml` and the library folders.

solidityWorkbench.index.includeTests.markdownDescription: Index the project test directory (`test` in `foundry.toml`).

solidityWorkbench.index.includeScripts.markdownDescription: Index the project script directory (`script` in `foundry.toml`).

solidityWorkbench.index.excludeLibTestsA.markdownDescription: Skip `test`, `tests`, `mock` and `mocks` folders inside library directories (`lib/`).

solidityWorkbench.index.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, relative to the project root, of Solidity files to leave out of the index. Example: `lib/**/certora/**`.

solidityWorkbench.autoImport.enabled.markdownDescription: Suggest symbols from the project and its dependencies in completions and add the import automatically.

enumDescriptions: Use the remapped path (e.g. `@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol`) when a remapping covers the file, else a relative path.
Always use a path relative to the importing file.
solidityWorkbench.autoImport.pathStyle.markdownDescription: Style of the paths written in new imports.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run build:prod
